description: "Trevlyn Hold: A Novel" by Mrs. Henry Wood is a work of fiction likely written in the late 19th century. The narrative centers around the lives and interpersonal dynamics of the Ryle and Trevlyn families in a rural English setting, detailing themes of class struggle, familial duty, and the impact of tragedy on community relationships.
